provenance: Frozen while the four learning_hard n=1 GitHub Actions shards were still in progress and before any hard-stress outcome or summary was inspected.
primary_estimand: For each domain, average held-out applicability-risk reduction (upstream minus calibration-gated DOVOD) across learner families with available predictive decision evidence; then average equally across domains.

primary_inference.exact_sign_flip: two-sided over nonzero per-domain mean reductions

coverage_rule: Retain every requested learner/domain cell as ok, failed, timeout, or predictive-bridge-unavailable; never silently drop unsupported cells.
claim_boundary: Exploratory native AMLGym learning_hard stress analysis. The protocol and this domain-clustered analysis were frozen before hard-stress outcomes were inspected, but the experiment was designed after partial primary-matrix inspection, so it is not a preregistered primary endpoint.
